7373: Holo is a wolf harvest deity originally from a land in the north known as Yoitsu. She made a promise with men from a town called Pasloe where she would ensure the town would have good wheat harvests year after year.
7374: Kraft Lawrence is a twenty-five-year-old traveling peddler who goes from town to town buying and selling various things in order to make a living. When he was twelve, he became an apprentice to a merchant relative, and set out on his own at eighteen.
7375: Chloe is a villager of Pasroe and has known Lawrence for a long time. In fact, Lawrence taught her how to be a merchant. Despite still not knowing how she should feel about him, she respects him as her teacher.
7376: She is a skilled shepherdess from a church-town named Lubinheigen. Her companion in this profession is a well-trained sheep dog named Enekk.
17825: A mysterious merchant that Lawrence and Holo meet on their journey when they visit a monastery. He suggests a "get rich quick" scheme to Lawrence involving reminted coins.
19670: He is a young man who works as a fish broker.
19671: Dian is an alchemist who is in the process of chronicling pagan tales and beliefs so as to print them in books.
24360: The manager of the large Pattio branch of the Milone Company. He is a calm, cool, and collected man who speaks very politely.
25153: A merchant staying at the same inn in Renos as Lawrence and Holo.
25802: Helena is a waitress working at the Tails of Beasts and Fishes restaurant in the town of Renose.
129255: He is a business worker for Hans Lemerio.
330869: Hans Remelio is the head of his Remelio Trading Company that was heading towards bankruptcy when first met by Lawrence and Holo.
